summary:
Programme enrollment now keeps complete identities and Roadmap declarations private while authenticating them through the existing fixed protected public source. The public enrollment/v3 document contains exactly schema and one commitment digest. The private version-4 binding contains a 32-byte cryptographic nonce and canonical padded Base64 of exact UTF-8 enrollment-payload/v1 bytes. The closed payload binds target, constructor provenance, allowed repositories and every selected issue/node/Roadmap row. The digest hashes the ASCII domain, one NUL, decoded nonce, unsigned eight-byte big-endian payload length and original bytes, never a reserialization. No public per-item hashes, payload, nonce or private-derived metadata are required. Product binding3/schema1 remains unchanged and rejects the programme field; no raw-public programme fallback is retained.

Binding acquisition uses one bounded opened handle before allocation; binding and private payload limits are 256 KiB and 128 KiB, with depth16 and duplicate/unknown/missing/encoding refusal. The shared decoder authenticates exact bytes against protected source before selected issue/plan reads. A final protected-main/blob/digest barrier follows slow inspection and remains before Observation writes and Verified no-ops. Failed currentness or authentication withholds global population selection. Ephemeral integrator input additionally joins the same required enrollmentCommitmentSha256; inspection2 reports only the matched digest, or null when unmatched, and binds it through protected-input provenance. Private v4 report paths use restrictive existing directories, exclusive0600 files and existing Linux-x64 directory durability barriers. Reports remain private because their normal native issue facts can contain private identities.

The maintained offline BoardV2Import preparation route shares the runtime validator. It checks all inputs and the final encoded-envelope bound before one RNG call, then retains exclusive restrictive disjoint output files with file/directory flush and independent pair readback. Collisions and partial failures preserve originals without overwrite, deletion, retry or reseeding. Generated files are preparation only; protected commitment delivery and qualified installed executable provenance still establish later admission. The existing linear offline CI gate includes shared-source/build dependencies and retains its locked restore, tests and10-minute limit; static path checks suffice without a new model or credential route.

The existing native and attributed-observation boundaries remain: complete membership/PR inventories, exact current heads/files/associations and action-specific prerequisites; caller-reported capacity/intake/reservations are not native authority. Ordered per-slice selection preserves existing owners and uncertain original holds. Source inspection grants no dispatch. The Observation-only writer preserves human planning and sends once with exact readback; uncertain responses do not retry. Current source builds passed without warnings/errors and complete focused projects passed101 projection,65 CLI and39 offline-tool cases, including prior migration controls. The first report-field omission and pre-RNG envelope-size finding were corrected with meaningful controls, not relabeled. These are source/inert controls, not native package, installed composition, protected enrollment, migration, UI or real-use acceptance. Original .103 Unknown and consumed .104 operations remain unreplayed.
title: Private programme enrollment authenticates complete bytes without public identity disclosure
